title: When restlessness keeps scattering the heart as a steady practice
issueStatement: Movement is increasing, but clarity is not. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru answers wandering with saint company, listening, and honest stillness. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: The mind settles less by roaming and more by right company. Choose better placement before choosing more movement.
actionPrompt: Choose better placement before choosing more movement. Repeat what you can actually keep.
